Condition : 1 - 10.1	The details submitted pursuant to condition 6 (Construction Logistics Plan) of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 1 July 2010; for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use), are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policies ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-P.1.5 Noise Pollution and ENV-P.1.6 Air Pollution of the adopted Unitary Development Plan; and 4A.3 Sustainable Design and Construction of the London Plan.

Condition 6 (Construction logistics plan) - 'Method Statement: The Construction Logistics & Traffic Management Plan at Kew Bridge Road' by Joseph Gallagher Ltd, dated 24 June 2010 (ref: JG/J522/MS04)
